Nothing can undo the pain as heard in the victims’ statements today. Melissa and Mark's legacy of service, kindness, and always showing up for others will be forever with us.

posts.text: Welcome back, Napheesa Collier!
Rondo Days is an important reminder of the strength and resilience that define the Rondo neighborhood in Saint Paul — it was great to see everyone this weekend.
I had a great time at Lumberjack Days. Stillwater sure knows how to celebrate! Thanks to Mayor Ted Kozlowski and the local businesses for hosting a fantastic parade, it was great to be a part of it.

Happy Rondo Days!

The Rondo neighborhood’s story is one of resilience, strength, and community. It was wonderful to celebrate Rondo Days with former Mayor Melvin Carter, Saint Paul Councilmember Anika Bowie, ReConnect Rondo Executive Director Keith Baker, and DFL-endorsed candidates Robyn Gulley (SD 65) and Sebastian Ellefson (65B), while honoring the generations who have made this neighborhood such an important part of Saint Paul and Minnesota.
